description: This file contains unit tests for the I18NLanguageAPI class within the OrangeHRM admin API module. It tests methods such as getAll, update, getOne, and delete, validating their behavior in different scenarios. The tests use fixtures, mock services, and test data providers to ensure API robustness.

classes.name: I18NLanguageAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the I18NLanguageAPI endpoints, including getAll, getOne, update, create, and delete functions within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.description: Tests the retrieval of all language entries through the API.
